promano@pc-arch ~/Descargas $ (
  set -euo pipefail
  cd ~/Descargas
  unzip -tq slack-update-phase-1-step-378-delivery.zip
  unzip -oq slack-update-phase-1-step-378-delivery.zip -d slack-update-step378-delivery
  cd slack-update-step378-delivery/step378-overlay

  bash apply-step378-overlay.sh /home/promano/GitHub/slack-update
  bash commit-step378.sh /home/promano/GitHub/slack-update --verify-only

  cd /home/promano/GitHub/slack-update
  STEP=phase-1-operational-successor-design-freeze-and-safe-pause-review
  bash "tests/reference/test-$STEP-harness.sh"

  git add -- CHANGELOG.md \
    "docs/reference/$STEP.md" \
    "tools/reference/$STEP.py" \
    "tests/reference/test-$STEP-harness.sh" \
    "tests/fixtures/reference/acceptance/phase-1/$STEP"-{confirmed377,step377-user-acceptance,freeze,pause-conditions,policy}.json

  git diff --cached --check
  git commit -m "Phase 1 step 378: freeze successor design and conditional safe pause"
  git push
  git status --short --untracked-files=all
  git log -1 --oneline
  git log -1 --oneline origin/main
)
